notes.title: Magma Trails Patch 3
notes.notes:
Gameplay

Added gamepad support for UI. Players should be able to navigate the game using just a controller across all panels (except the Settings menu). 

Performance

Added a DirectX 11 Option in Settings which should help anyone experiencing poor performance or crashing. This mostly affected older raytracing GPUs and some AMD GPUs. 

Leaderboards

Added a ranking number and score to the UI scene. 

Leaderboards are now cached locally and should be more responsive when paging through. 

Controls

Added an invert Y option. 

Bug Fixes

Players can now access the Esc Menu on the login screen as well as the post game / score screen.
